description: This file defines the configuration class for the SystemCheck plugin in the OrangeHRM system, implementing interfaces for plugin configuration and console command registration. It contains methods to initialize the plugin (currently empty) and to register console commands, specifically the ToggleSystemCheckScreenCommand.

classes.name: SystemCheckPluginConfiguration
classes.description: Configuration class for the SystemCheck plugin, implementing plugin setup and console command registration interfaces.

methods.name: initialize
methods.description: Initializes the plugin with the provided request; currently empty.

methods.name: registerCommands
methods.description: Registers console commands, specifically adding the ToggleSystemCheckScreenCommand to the console.
